concept.title: Egypt, *an international edition.*
concept.subtitle: A Founders Club retreat in Egypt between February and April 2027: three settings, with NOYA running the ground and the club keeping the room.
concept.lead: Egypt offers an international edition few destinations can match: Giza, the Red Sea and the Nile, within one country. The club keeps the members, the programme and the speakers; NOYA runs the venues, stays, movement and every detail on the ground.

why.label: Your calendar
why.text: International retreats and founder getaways are already part of the Founders Club year.

options.title: The Giza summit
options.text: Three days in Cairo: sessions by day, a private evening facing the Pyramids, and the Grand Egyptian Museum before departure.

options.title: The Red Sea retreat
options.text: El Gouna for four days: sessions in the morning, the sea in the afternoon, members together in villas or one resort.
meta: Villas or resort, boats, dinners, wellness

options.title: The Nile mastermind
options.text: A small group between Luxor and Aswan: riverside hotels, a private Nile journey and conversations among the temples.

email.subject: Re: Egypt support for Founders Club retreats
paragraphs: As the 2027 calendar takes shape, one idea for an international edition: a Founders Club retreat in Egypt, between February and April.

Three ways it could work: a Giza summit with a private evening facing the Pyramids, a Red Sea retreat in El Gouna, or a small mastermind on the Nile between Luxor and Aswan. Your team keeps the members, the programme and the speakers; NOYA runs the venues, stays, movement and everything on the ground.
Happy to share the detail and talk it through whenever suits.
